name: Dragon's Dogma 2
notes: RE Engine DX12 → D3DMetal (Resident Evil 4 remake class). Prefer DD2.exe over DD.exe with SteamAppId=2054970. Ray tracing is DXR via D3DMetal on M3/M4; DLSS cannot run on Apple Silicon. First run hitching is PSO translation. Capcom anti-cheat / Denuvo are not expected to work under Wine — this profile is for the local/single-player path. Pin CX_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal. Do not use Libraries.rgl or Libraries.vk.
